240	def iter_docstrings(item_class: type, attr_names: AbstractSet[str]) -> Iterator[tuple[str, str]]:
241	    try:
242	        source = inspect.getsource(item_class)
243	    except (OSError, TypeError):
244	        return
245	    tree = ast.parse(dedent(source))
246	    class_node = None
247	    for node in tree.body:
248	        if isinstance(node, ast.ClassDef) and node.name == item_class.__name__:
249	            class_node = node
250	            break
251	    if class_node is None:  # pragma: no cover
252	        # This can be reproduced with the doctests of the README, but the
253	        # coverage data does not seem to include those.
254	        return
255	    assert isinstance(class_node, ast.ClassDef)
256	    for child in ast.iter_child_nodes(class_node):
257	        if isinstance(child, ast.Assign) and isinstance(child.targets[0], ast.Name):
258	            attr_name = child.targets[0].id
259	        elif isinstance(child, ast.AnnAssign) and isinstance(child.target, ast.Name):
260	            attr_name = child.target.id
261	        else:
262	            continue
263	        if attr_name not in attr_names:
264	            continue
265	        next_idx = class_node.body.index(child) + 1
266	        if next_idx >= len(class_node.body):
267	            continue
268	        next_node = class_node.body[next_idx]
269	        if (
270	            isinstance(next_node, ast.Expr)
271	            and isinstance(next_node.value, ast.Constant)
272	            and isinstance(next_node.value.value, str)
273	        ):
274	            yield attr_name, next_node.value.value
